heading: Today
text: Some low clouds and a few patches of fog, then clouds breaking for limited sun north, and partly sunny in southern valleys.  Warmer.  Highs in the upper 60s to low 70s.  Winds light and variable, becoming south near 10 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, giving way to some partial clearing.  Mild.  Lows in the upper 40s and 50s.  Winds south 5 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west, remaining light east.

heading: Thursday
text: Variable clouds and sun.  Clouds thickening in the afternoon through NY and the St. Lawrence, with a shower possible late.  Warm.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds becoming south to southwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph from the Green Mountains west.
